subject: general
question:
A cube is made by folding the given sheet. In the cube so formed, which pair of letters will** NOT** be on the opposite faces?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/190460988e35e08b3bd5cb409287e445b726d1271107da62e426ef3098b6ac87.png]
solution:
Opposite surface of the open dice can be found by the below method:-

 
• Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other.
 
• No two opposite surface are touched by side or by corners.

So, by using the above rule we can find the opposite surface of open dice.

In the given figure, Opposite faces are :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d9a5a89e2c3675938838c7c5993c357de6d77c4a4adeec63cecefd473a3509a.png] 

 
 

 Alphabets
 Opposite
 
 

 K
 N
 
 

 P
 O
 
 

 L
 M
 
 

 

∴ Here, the pair of letters which are not opposite are 'O and M'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"O and M".**
